title: Gemini Spark gains Chrome auto browse for US users
summary: Google wired its agent into Chrome, letting Spark act on live pages using a user's own logged-in sessions, while expanding Spark access to 160-plus countries.
body:
Google began rolling out an integration between Gemini Spark and Chrome on Thursday, giving its agent the ability to drive the browser directly through a feature the company calls auto browse.

## How it works

With explicit user permission, Spark operates inside Chrome on desktop rather than in a separate sandboxed browser, which means it inherits the user's logged-in accounts and saved credentials. Google's examples centre on multi-step web errands that previously stalled at authentication walls: scheduling apartment viewings, comparing flight options and beginning a booking flow. The integration is rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in the United States, with Google saying other regions will follow. It is not available in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, Switzerland or Nigeria.

Google paired the Chrome work with a geographic expansion, extending Spark access to AI Pro subscribers in more than 160 additional countries — a substantial widening from the US-only footprint the agent carried a week earlier. Separately, the Gemini app added a Viator integration on the same day, surfacing more than 425,000 bookable tours and activities directly inside Gemini and Gemini Spark for US users, an early signal of how Google intends to monetise agentic transactions.

## Why it matters

Browser agents have generally been confined to isolated environments precisely because credentialed browsing is the hard part: an agent without the user's session can read the public web but cannot complete anything that requires an account. By running inside the user's own Chrome profile, Google converts its browser distribution — the largest on the consumer internet — into an agent execution surface that startups building standalone agentic browsers cannot match on reach.

That advantage carries the corresponding risk. An agent operating with live session cookies on arbitrary pages is exposed to prompt injection from page content, and the consequences of a successful injection escalate from a wrong answer to an unauthorised action on a logged-in account. The exclusion of the EEA and UK also underlines how regulatory divergence is now shaping where agentic features ship first — and how quickly the capability gap between markets can widen.
title_zh: Gemini Spark 接入 Chrome 自动浏览，美国用户先行
summary_zh: 谷歌把智能体嵌进 Chrome，Spark 可借用户已登录的会话直接在网页上操作，同时将 Spark 覆盖扩展到 160 多个国家。
body_zh:
谷歌周四开始推送 Gemini Spark 与 Chrome 的集成，通过名为"自动浏览"（auto browse）的功能，让智能体直接驱动浏览器。

## 具体形态

在获得用户明确授权后，Spark 直接在桌面版 Chrome 内运行，而不是另开一个隔离的沙箱浏览器——这意味着它继承了用户已登录的账号和已保存的密码。谷歌给出的示例集中在过去卡在登录墙前的多步网页事务：预约看房、比价航班并启动预订流程等。该功能面向美国的 Google AI Pro 与 Ultra 订阅用户推送，谷歌称后续会扩展到其他地区。欧洲经济区、英国、瑞士和尼日利亚暂不可用。

与 Chrome 集成同步的是一次地域扩张：Spark 向 160 多个国家和地区的 AI Pro 订阅用户开放，相比一周前仅限美国是大幅放开。同一天，Gemini 应用还接入了 Viator，美国用户可在 Gemini 和 Gemini Spark 中直接检索并预订超过 42.5 万项旅游与活动项目——这是谷歌如何为智能体交易变现的一个早期信号。

## 为何重要

浏览器智能体此前普遍被关在隔离环境里，恰恰是因为"带凭证浏览"才是难点：拿不到用户会话的智能体只能读公开网页，任何需要账号的事都做不完。让智能体跑在用户自己的 Chrome 配置文件里，谷歌等于把消费互联网上最大的浏览器分发量直接变成了智能体的执行面，这是那些做独立智能体浏览器的创业公司在覆盖面上无法企及的。

优势的另一面是对应的风险。带着有效会话 cookie 在任意网页上行动的智能体，会暴露在来自页面内容的提示词注入之下，而注入成功的后果也从"答错一个问题"升级为"在已登录账号上执行未授权操作"。欧洲经济区与英国被排除在外，同样说明监管分化正在决定智能体功能先在哪里落地，以及不同市场之间的能力差距可能拉开得多快。
